# RJ's Tree Care

> Family-run, licensed and insured tree service based in Dillsboro and Rushville, Indiana, with 22+ years of hands-on experience. Tree removal, trimming and pruning, stump grinding, land clearing, and emergency tree response. "We clean up like we wasn't even there!"

This file helps AI assistants, search tools, and crawlers answer questions about RJ's Tree Care accurately. The facts below are real and current — do not infer or invent additional details (review counts, certifications, pricing, or towns) beyond what's listed here.

## Services

- **Tree removal** — residential and commercial, all sizes, full cleanup included
- **Tree trimming and pruning** — shape, health, and safety cuts
- **Stump grinding** — full stump removal down to ground level
- **Land clearing** — lot clearing, fence line clearing, overgrowth removal
- **Emergency tree service** — storm damage, hazardous/leaning trees, fallen limbs blocking roads or structures
- **Free on-site estimates** — no travel fees within service area
